description: Test suite for nested path support in JSON-like data structures, specifically testing deletion of nested values using JSONPath-like syntax. Contains multiple test classes that validate functionality for nested path detection, deletion logic, wildcards, array indices, and complex nested patterns.

classes.name: TestIsNestedPath
classes.description: Contains tests for detection of nested paths based on string patterns, such as dots or array notation.

classes.name: TestDeleteNestedValue
classes.description: Contains tests for the core deletion logic, verifying removal of nested fields from data structures, including arrays and specific indices.

classes.name: TestComplexNestedPatterns
classes.description: Tests complex nested patterns with multiple wildcards, deep nesting, and a combination of different JSONPath-like expressions.

methods.name: test_top_level_path(self)
methods.description: Verifies that top-level paths without nesting return False when checked with is_nested_path.

methods.name: test_nested_path_with_dot(self)
methods.description: Verifies that paths containing dot notation are correctly identified as nested paths.

methods.name: test_nested_path_with_array(self)
methods.description: Verifies that paths with array notation are correctly identified as nested paths.

methods.name: test_array_wildcard_removes_field_from_all_elements(self)
methods.description: Tests that delete_nested_value correctly removes a field from all array elements when using wildcards.

methods.name: test_specific_array_index_removes_field_from_single_element(self)
methods.description: Tests deletion of a nested field from a specific array element using explicit index notation.

methods.name: test_multiple_jsonpath_patterns_in_list(self)
methods.description: Tests applying multiple JSONPath patterns sequentially to a data structure and verifies the correct fields are removed in nested structures.

methods.name: test_remove_entire_nested_array_field(self)
methods.description: Verifies removal of entire array fields, not just array elements.

methods.name: test_triple_nested_wildcards(self)
methods.description: Tests deep nesting with multiple wildcards in JSONPath-like expressions.

methods.name: test_combination_of_simple_and_complex_paths(self)
methods.description: Verifies that mixing simple nested paths and complex multi-wildcard patterns works as expected.

methods.name: test_mixed_wildcards_and_indices_with_deep_nesting(self)
methods.description: Tests combining wildcards, specific indices, and deep nesting with multiple complex paths.
